description: PLSAT v3.0: passage-based question groups and question variants. New v3.0.json schema with items[], variants, and passage groups. Server resolves variants (random pick) and flattens passage groups before sending to client. UI renders passage blocks above grouped questions. 2 passage groups (portal.yaml review, .purpose file review), 5 questions with 2 variants each. Total stays at 50 questions.
